story_systems.highest_priority_gate: stress test the kit with a photographed real-product label and narration-timed video integration

global_rules: A format consumes an ingredient pack; it must not copy a complete story.
Every visual must have provenance, status, approved uses, and avoid rules.
Every efficacy claim must resolve to a traceable evidence record.
Medical injection evidence cannot support an intact-skin topical claim.
No new generation during the initial harvest phase.
A story system may consume ingredient packs but must not own or duplicate their scientific facts.
Missing label information must render as not disclosed or not established.
